issue_request: Published/Persuasive OO change request to bind SpecimenDefinition.typeTested.container.material to an Example value set for specimen container materials, including SNOMED CT glass, plastic, and metal; Jira's final resolution says the change had already been applied.
initial_application: No Jira-tagged FHIR-19425 source commit was found. additional_context: source/fhir.ini actively lists specimendefinition in the current build. OO Confluence minutes from April and June 2021 record FHIR-19425 as already applied/pre-applied and approved in the April block vote. The current canonical is http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/container-material, not the Jira description's proposed specimen-container-material URL, but the binding and value set definition are internally consistent and changing the canonical now would be a compatibility-affecting rename beyond the applied request.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit. No source change was made because source/specimendefinition/structuredefinition-SpecimenDefinition.xml already binds SpecimenDefinition.typeTested.container.material to the example ContainerMaterial value set, and source/specimendefinition/valueset-container-material.xml already includes glass, plastic, and metal.
